title: The drawing, on a fridge
logline: The father's kid's crayon drawing — the tree taller than the house, 2001 — in its red frame, on a refrigerator in 2024, held by magnets, in a kitchen where the kid is the parent now. A lunchbox on the counter.

panels.composition: A kitchen: a refrigerator with a small red-framed crayon drawing held on by two magnets — a house, a tree taller than it, a six-legged dog — among school notices and a child's newer drawing beside it. A lunchbox on the counter. Morning.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a kitchen refrigerator with a small red-framed child's crayon drawing of a house and an oversized tree held on by magnets among school notices and a newer child's drawing, a lunchbox on the counter, morning, no people, no words
image.notes: dw_2001-02-05 / dw_2011-05-17. The kid is the parent. Reserved which house.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Framed by a father who said nothing; on a fridge a generation on.
